prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity product design comparison board for OmniGear, a universal web app for configuring mice and keyboards. This is an exploratory home-screen preview, not a marketing website. Render a single image containing TWO COMPLETE DESKTOP APP VIEWPORTS stacked vertically with a slim neutral separator: top BLACK THEME, bottom WHITE THEME. Each viewport has a wide 16:9 aspect, image overall near square. Both viewports must show IDENTICAL CONTENT AND LAYOUT, only the theme changes. No laptop frames, browser toolbars, perspective or annotations outside the two screens.
STRUCTURE in each viewport: slim full-width header with 'OmniGear' left as a simple wordmark, small pill 'Demonstração' nearby, and a sun/moon theme toggle at right with visible 'Claro' and 'Escuro' labels. Main content generous but efficient, width roughly 85% centered. A 32px heading 'Seus dispositivos', small secondary line 'Selecione um periférico para configurar.' and right-aligned primary '+ Adicionar dispositivo' button. LAST USED DEVICE FEATURE. Below the heading a wide elegant horizontal featured row with large black gaming mouse on the left, 'Usado recentemente', device name, connection and 'Configurar' action on the right. Below one more compact row for the gray keyboard, clearly secondary but still immediately reachable. Same arrangement in both themes.
CONTENT: Use only fictional demo hardware names 'Mouse de demonstração' and 'Teclado de demonstração', with small secondary labels 'Mouse · USB' and 'Teclado · USB'. Show a quiet lower helper link 'Precisa de ajuda para conectar?' No manufacturer logos, real brand names, compatibility counts, commercial claims, invented battery figures, cloud, login, marketing copy, charts, sidebars, filters or extra dashboard widgets on this home. Render realistic dark gaming mouse and gray mechanical keyboard cutouts with full silhouettes visible, no RGB spectacle.
VISUAL SYSTEM: precision and restraint of dedicated gaming peripheral configuration software like the provided ATK-style visual references. Flat monochrome surfaces with fine borders, consistent small rounded corners, simple monochrome icons, excellent readable modern sans-serif typography, deliberate strong hierarchy and comfortable spacing. The hardware is the focus and the screen feels like a useful application. BLACK theme: neutral almost-black #111111 ground, #191919 panels, crisp offwhite text, white primary button with black text. WHITE theme: light gray #f5f5f5 ground, pure white panels, almost-black text, black primary button with white text. Carefully designed white theme with independently legible boundaries; keep neutral grayscale, no tinted accents. Top theme switch says Escuro active; bottom says Claro active. Avoid giant headings, extraneous boxes, gradients behind UI, neon, colored backgrounds, decorative illustrations. ALL PORTUGUESE TEXT must be clean, precise and legible.
